lines.text: Jehoshaphat visits Ahab in Samaria, and Ahab urges him toward Ramoth-gilead, and Jehoshaphat agrees to join the war.
Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire first for the word of the LORD, so Ahab assembles four hundred prophets.
Zedekiah son of Chenaanah makes a wooden yoke and declares that with it Ahab will gore the Arameans.
